scope: DataView Save boundary identified by document-handoff-restored-runtime.json
behavior: Save captures the selected document, fields, name, route, and domain before awaiting organization selection. It checks the canonical page identity and save generation again immediately before savePattern, so a same-URL replacement cannot persist old fields.

A page change invalidates the in-flight save generation, releases the new page's Save control, and shows a precise recovery message. An old write or refresh completion cannot clear the new page's fields, set its result or error, or end its newer save.

red.result: ADMITTED, 2 new cases failed against original source: A wrote old fields after B replaced the document during deferred organization lookup; A's pending write kept B Save disabled. 15 existing tests passed.

limits: The component regression uses mocked Chrome identity, organization resolution, and persistence; native same-URL reload and real database persistence remain unverified.
A write already submitted before navigation cannot be revoked; the new page says to check saved patterns before retrying.
